claims.statement: For every C >= 1/2 in the specified admissible family the unique positive equilibrium has exactly two right-half-plane eigenvalues, while both resident equilibria are resident-stable and mutually invasible.
For the specified family almost every strictly positive initial condition does not converge to an equilibrium.
claims.qualification: Does not classify limit sets or prove global periodic attraction.

claims.statement: Varying q at C=1/2 produces a certified local supercritical Hopf bifurcation near 0.97691614864474158 with stable positive periodic solutions on the specified side.
claims.qualification: No explicit radius; no certified periodic orbit at q=0.98.
